expected_constraints: [Security] Each team owner will need to use a username and password in order to be authenticated to reach the team owners page
[Security] The Commissioner will be the only authorized user per league to adjust league settings.
[Look & Feel] Each page shall contain a navigation menu which shows the index into which the current page is contained.
[Look & Feel] Each page shall contain a similar format with action items in one location and navigation buttons in a different location.
[Look & Feel] The message board shall contain the 5 most recently posted messages on the league page. The messages will contain up to the first 150 characters of the message.
[Usability] A new user shall be able to navigate through the league and team pages within 30 seconds of reaching the start-up page.
[Usability] Users shall be able to reach the add  drop  and trade player pages with one click from the team owners page.
[Usability] Users shall be able to view at least 25 NFL player statistics and points on each page.
[Usability] The application shall ask the user to confirm dropping a player or trading a player before performing the action.
[Performance] The application shall be able to complete every user transaction within one fourth of a second of receiving the request over the network.
[Availability] The application shall have a downtime of at most 10 minutes per year.
[Operational] The application shall run on a web application server.
[Operational] A primary database will be used to store cached data for active users.
[Operational] A secondary database will be used to store historical statistics and data.
[Maintainability] Application updates shall occur between 3AM and 6 AM CST on Wednesday morning during the middle of the NFL season.
[Maintainability] New System version releases shall be released at the beginning of each NFL season.
